title: Women of the Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Women of the Bible Crossword
description: Solve a women of the Bible crossword: Eve, Sarah, Miriam, Deborah, Ruth, Esther, Mary and Martha. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: From the mother of all living to the women at the empty tomb, this puzzle gathers them across both testaments: Sarah laughing in the tent door, Miriam with a timbrel, Deborah judging under her palm tree, Rahab, Ruth, Hannah, Abigail, Esther, Mary, Martha, Lydia, Priscilla.
Women of the Bible asks you to match the woman to the detail that identifies her, which is a good test of how closely you have read. The closing verse is from the last chapter of Proverbs.

clues.text: She said, “thy people shall be my people”
Sister of Moses, who took a timbrel
Prophetess and judge, under her palm tree

verseText: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
